# varco diff

Compare two endpoints.

## Usage

```text
varco diff [options]
```

## Flags

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `-allow-unsafe-methods` | `bool` | `false` | allow methods other than GET, HEAD, OPTIONS |
| `-format` | `string` | `table` | table or json |
| `-header` | `value` | `""` | request header NAME=VALUE (repeatable) |
| `-host` | `string` | `""` | HTTP Host header |
| `-ignore-header` | `value` | `""` | response header to ignore (repeatable) |
| `-method` | `string` | `GET` | HTTP method |
| `-new` | `string` | `""` | new numeric IP endpoint |
| `-old` | `string` | `""` | old numeric IP endpoint |
| `-rate` | `float` | `5` | maximum requests per second |
| `-scheme` | `string` | `https` | http or https |
| `-show-sensitive` | `bool` | `false` | show raw sensitive Location values |
| `-sni` | `string` | `""` | TLS server name (defaults to host) |
| `-timeout` | `duration` | `10s` | per-request timeout |

The help output leaves out a default that equals the zero value of the flag type; the table above shows that zero value.
